sdc.decision.AutonomyLevel.title: AutonomyLevel
sdc.decision.AutonomyLevel.description: The run's autonomy level, docs/autonomy-levels.md:36-42 and :205-213: A0 Manual, A1 Advised, A2 Internal, A3 To merge, A4 To release, A5 Unattended (eval runs, :41-42). The level does not decide eligibility by itself: with the request's decision class it gives the holder (:241-256, overrides :297-320), and the guards read the holder.
